hooks.prompt:
Quick project orientation: First check if thoughts/STATE.md exists — if so, read it and summarize the current project state. Then check git status, recent commits, and any in-progress work. Give a 3-line summary prioritizing STATE.md context if available.

Context: $ARGUMENTS

hooks.command: if [ -f .claude/.loop-owner ]; then HB=$(grep -o '"heartbeat":[0-9]*' .claude/.loop-owner | grep -o '[0-9]*'); if [ -n "$HB" ] && [ $(( $(date +%s) - HB )) -ge 900 ]; then rm -f .claude/.loop-owner; fi; fi; exit 0
if [ -f .claude/.loop-owner ] && grep -q '"owner":"machine"' .claude/.loop-owner; then rm -f .claude/.loop-owner; fi; exit 0

hooks.prompt:
A subagent has finished. Based on the metadata below, assess if it completed successfully.
Consider the agent type and whether the session ended normally.
Respond with {"ok": true} if it appears complete, or {"ok": false, "reason": "..."} if something seems off.

IMPORTANT: If stop_hook_active is true, always respond {"ok": true} to prevent infinite loops.

Context: $ARGUMENTS
